stops.note: possibly meaning 'snow shoveler', describing how the animal digs through snow
Mi'kmaq 'qalipu', snow-shoveller, for how the animal paws through snow to feed
appeared as early as 1609 in Pierre Erondelle's English translation of Marc Lescarbot's account of New France; used in North America, while the same animal in Eurasia is called reindeer

current_meaning: a North American reindeer, found in Arctic and subarctic regions
